seo.title: CueBooker | Booking for DJs, promoters and agencies
seo.description: Centralise availability, requests and electronic music booking follow-up. A functional CueBooker prototype.

hero.body: Find artists available for your date, send a complete request and take the booking through to confirmation in one connected thread.
proofs: Replies and follow-up in one booking

problem.title: Too many channels. No shared state.
problem.body: A contact may start on Instagram, WhatsApp, email or a website. CueBooker turns that first conversation into a structured request so the DJ knows what to answer, what is pending and which date is confirmed.
problem.statement: Every contact needs a next action.

search.title: Make the date make sense.
search.body: The demo crosses date, sound, city and budget. Each DJ or agency decides what availability they share and who receives the request.

flow.title: One booking. One thread. One next action.
flow.body: The promoter can explore and prepare a request without an account. When sending it, they register to receive replies, negotiate and confirm. The DJ or agency works from their workspace and keeps control of the date.

roles.eyebrow: THE DJ ACTIVATES THEIR BOOKING NETWORK
roles.title: Start with artists. Connect everyone else.

items.name: Independent DJ
items.headline: Your profile, availability and every enquiry.
items.body: Create your account, share your link on Instagram, Linktree or your website and turn scattered messages into trackable requests.

items.name: Promoter or venue
items.headline: Find who is actually available.
items.body: Explore without registering. Create an account when you send the request to receive replies, negotiate and confirm the date.

items.name: Manager or agency
items.headline: Your roster stays under your control.
items.body: Register the agency, add artists and route each enquiry to the right person with private permissions, fees and calendars.

access.eyebrow: AN ACCOUNT WHEN IT STARTS ADDING VALUE
access.title: How each person enters CueBooker.
access.body: The network starts with DJs and agencies publishing profiles and controlling availability. The promoter enters when they turn a search or shared link into a real booking.
access.demoNote: This screen demonstrates the access model. Registration, authentication and shared persistence will be connected in the next phase.

cta.title: We are building CueBooker with DJs and people who book real dates.
cta.body: We are looking for independent DJs, agencies and promoters to test this flow before registration opens. Show us how you work and take part in product decisions.
